# SPM IAS Academy

> > SPM IAS Academy is a premier coaching institute specializing in UPSC Civil Services Examination and APSC (Assam Public Service Commission) preparation, with proven success rates and comprehensive guidance for IAS, IPS, and state service aspirants.

Based in Guwahati, SPM IAS Academy focuses on both national (UPSC) and regional (APSC) civil services examinations, offering specialized coaching for optional subjects, state-specific papers, and complete exam preparation strategies. The academy achieved an 82.55% success rate in APSC 2023.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Civil Services Examination
- APSC (Assam Public Service Commission)
- IAS, IPS, IFS preparation
- APSC Mains GS Paper 5 (Assam Paper)
- UPSC optional subjects (Anthropology, Assamese)
- Exam eligibility and attempt rules
- Answer writing strategy
- APSC recruitment notifications
- State government jobs in Assam
- UPSC Mains preparation
- Regional studies and Assam-specific topics
- Civil services exam syllabus
- UPSC scholarships and financial aid
- Northeast India administrative services
